description:
One action on one open document (ZEN-2): an action its row offers, with its ``version``.

``accept`` posts the held proposal; ``reject`` closes it unposted (a person books the
document); ``keep``, ``reanalyze``, ``mark_irrelevant``, ``delete``; ``skip`` / ``unskip``
leave it to a person. All but accept and unskip need a ``reason``. Recorded with your user;
an agent decides a hold only where the owner allowed it. Returns the new status.

On this MCP surface a `null` argument means "not provided": it is dropped before the request is sent, exactly as if the field were omitted.
name: book_documents_act
